text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Alert: High tail latency observed on streaming endpoints (/v1/stream). p95 & p99 spiking in eu-west-1 starting 14:03 UTC. Auto-mitigation triggered: proxy backpressure rules. Link: https://dash.redwood/alerts/8701234567
ashley_oncall: ack I'm on it. Paging SREs and infra. @sam_sre @kevin_infra can you grab traces + proxy metrics?
sam_sre: on it. quick look: proxy write queue on edge-proxy-12 trending up, many connections in WRITE_WAIT. p99 moved from ~120ms -> ~2.3s for a subset of streaming routes. grabbing flamegraph + traces now.
kevin_infra: LB/backends look healthy (200s), but edge-proxy upstream conns at ~95% of configured limit on node-12. possible connection churn / slow clients. I'll restart proxy on node-12 and roll the pool.
maria_support: CS reported CUST-214 seeing streaming stalls at 14:07 UTC, they observe long pauses between chunks in their app. Ticket created: CS-4632
jules_csm: pinged Pando Labs (key customer) to let them know we're investigating. They are on eu-west-1, asked for ETA.
ops-bot: Runbook triggered: streaming-backpressure -> step 2 (increase proxy tcp_keepalive to 90s, temporarily reduce connection reuse).
ashley_oncall: applying mitigations: we can try a rolling restart + throttle accepts for problematic path. @kevin_infra please paste the restart commands you're running.
kevin_infra: Running now:
```
kubectl scale deployment/edge-proxy -n infra --replicas=8
kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n infra --selector=az=eu-west-1
```
Also applied `sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1` on the nodes to reduce TIME_WAIT backlog.
sam_sre: after the restart p95 improved to ~340ms, p99 still ~1.1s. Traces show SSE chunk serialization queued inside the proxy write loop — likely client-slow-consumers are filling proxy buffers which delays subsequent writes.
maria_support: customer confirms partial improvement but still seeing ~1s stalls on heavy sessions.
ashley_oncall: temporary app-level workaround: reduce server chunk size and enable keepalive pings to detect slow clients earlier. This should make proxy writes smaller and avoid long write stalls.
sam_sre: deployed quick config change to streaming tier:
```
streaming:
  max_chunk_size: 512
  client_write_timeout_ms: 800
  proxy_queue_limit: 64
```
Monitoring dashboards now.
ops-bot: Current metrics snapshot -> p95=320ms, p99=920ms, proxy_conn_use=70%, write_queue_fill=45%.
kevin_infra: notes for follow-up: implement accept-time backpressure and per-client drain timers; consider flow-control ACKs for long-lived streams. I'll open an RFC and include measurements.
ashley_oncall: handoff for watch: I'm handing to night shift. If p99 > 1.5s for >5m escalate to eng-runtime and page on-call leads. Leaving playbook + commands in the incident ticket.
sam_sre: added notes to incident: probable root cause = increased keepalive/reuse behavior introduced in edge-proxy change last week; plan rollback in next maintenance window if recurrence.
jules_csm: Pando Labs updated — they see reduced impact and appreciate the quick response. Recording customer impact: intermittent degraded streaming (stalls up to ~1s), affected customers: Pando Labs, CUST-218, ~<5% active streaming sessions.
ashley_oncall: updating incident ticket https://redwood/incident/8701234567. Mitigations closed as active but staying on watch for 1h. If anything regresses, re-open and escalate. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (moved to WATCH). Severity lowered to Sev-2. Notifying on-call rotation for watch and follow-up postmortem tasks.
